metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to complete full 10-sheet reorder due to imprecise screen coordinate targeting for tab drag-and-drop operations. Ran out of turns (50) with many sheets still misplaced.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single cell edit on a known sheet. Model demonstrated ability to navigate sheets and type values. Tests basic cell editing capability without complex drag operations.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the ReadMe sheet and typing text in cell A10. Evaluator reads the cell value and checks if it contains the expected text (case-insensitive substring match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cell A10 from the 'ReadMe' sheet of the target xlsx file, matching the instruction exactly.
Metric correctly accesses expected.get('expected_text') - proper parameter handling for type='rule' where expected IS the rules dictionary.
Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring the cell value is persisted to disk for openpyxl to read.
Expected text 'Data Assignment - Niger Market Analysis' matches the instruction verbatim.
Case-insensitive substring match is a reasonable and slightly forgiving comparison for text entry verification.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (type text in a specific cell) is fully verified by the single getter+metric pair.
